title: Official regulatory information — candidate source
notes: The Egyptian Drug Authority is the official regulatory authority. Its public website is recorded as the authoritative starting point; a public searchable human-medicines register, bulk export/API, update cadence and reuse terms have not yet been confirmed. Do not treat this homepage as a verified product feed.

title: Egyptian Drug Database (eg-drugs) — community-maintained dataset and public API
notes: Repository and README inspected on 2026-11-20. Maintainer claims 27,617+ records. CC BY 4.0 attribution is required. Dataset/API content, record-level provenance, coverage, price freshness and uptime have not been independently audited; not an official EDA register.
evidence_reference: Repository README and LICENSE-DATA declare CC BY 4.0 and document JSON/CSV/SQLite/SQL exports and REST API. This verifies what the repository publishes, not the underlying clinical accuracy or completeness.
